針と深爪 by スズオ
抜間茶目は 駄目すぎる by ねる
逃げた先に あるものは by みかん氏

n: The Case Files of Jeweler Richard
j: 宝石商リチャード氏の謎鑑定
d: When Seigi Nakata rescued a handsome young jewelry appraiser from a group of drunken assailants, he got more than he bargained for! The appraiser is Richard Ranasinghe de Vulpian, a brilliant and mysterious British jewelry expert. Seigi hires him to appraise a family heirloom…and that is just the beginning. Together, they unlock the secret messages hidden in the hearts of precious stones–and those who possess them.
Note: Published in Young Ace September 2025 issue.

A collection of one-shots by Sakisaka Io.

1. Mascara Blues (マスカラ ブルース)

Mugino is a normal high school girl who is extremely excited about love and is in the constant search for it.  But it seems that no matter how obsessed she is with a guy, the moment the feeling is reciprocated, she falls right back out of love.  Will she ever be able to break the cycle?

2. Romance no Rinkaku (ロマンスの輪郭)

When commuting to school one day, Tsuda-san tripped and spilled the entire contents of her bag on the street in front of the bus.  Flustered and embarrassed, she didn't catch a glimpse of the kind person who helped her gather her things, nor did she even thank him.  Feeling guilty ever since, she's tried to find him, but with no luck so far...

3. Watashi ga Watashi de Aru Tame ni: Nagai Yume (私が私であるためにー長い夢ー)

Hikaru first met Mashima-san, a hair-stylist student, when he ran into her on the street and offered to cut Hikaru's hair for free.  Hikaru's friends warned that hair-stylists are notorious players, but Hikaru meets Mashima-san again anyway and feels even more attracted to him.  Can Hikaru trust Mashima-san enough to tell him everything?

n: Yuri Tama: From Third Wheel to Trifecta
r: Yuri no Aida ni Hasamareta Watashi ga, Ikioi de Futamata Shite Shimatta Hanashi
j: 百合の間に挟まれたわたしが、勢いで二股してしまった話
d: Yuna Momose and Rinka Aiba were made for each other, and their whole school knows it. Between Yuna's princess-like elegance and Rinka's prince-like charm, all their classmates see them as the ideal couple. Yotsuba Hazama is no exception to that, but she is exceptional in another way: she's somehow managed to become fast friends with both of them! Having the whole school's favorite ship as her two best friends isn't exactly easy, though. Not only does it make everyone treat Yotsuba like a particularly obnoxious third wheel, it makes her feel like one too! Or at least it does, until one day, Yuna asks her out. And then Rinka asks her out too! And Yotsuba, whose social anxiety never seems to kick in until after she's already messed something up...says yes to both of them, without sparing so much as a single thought for the consequences. Oops! Now Yotsuba only has one choice: keep her accidental two-timing under wraps and make both of her new girlfriends as happy as she possibly can!

After a long war, Lycoris, a princess of the Wyvern Kingdom, and Raika, a princess of the Dragon Kingdom, are to be married as a sign of peace. Former enemies, the two begin a new life together…

Lycoris has complicated feelings about the political marriage, but she can't help becoming attracted to Raika, who seems so lonely, despite her outward indifference.

Two girls who do not know how to love, bond with each other as they heal each other's broken hearts.

n: It's Not As If I Wanted to Dress Like a Woman
r: Bing Bushi Wo Xiang Dang Mishu
d:
For a tripled salary, Lin Zicheng, a straight man put on a woman's dress to go to work. He just did not expect Gu Fang, a CEO who never liked women would fall in love at first sight with his cross-dressed self! 

Wasn't it rumored that the chief's orientation is questionable, since he never approached women? 

"Where's your modesty, chief?!"

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

Notes: 

- Chapter count includes 7 extras

- Originally published under the title Bing Bushi Wo Xiang Chuan Nü Zhuang (并不是我想穿女装, It's Not Like I Want to Dress Like a Woman), which was later changed to Bing Bushi Wo Xiang Dang Mishu (并不是我想当秘书, It's Not Like I Want to be a Secretary)

n: Fudanshi Shoukan: Isekai de Shinjuu ni Hameraremashita Mini Anime
r: Fudanshi Shoukan: Isekai de Shinjuu ni Hameraremashita Mini Anime
j: 【腐男子召喚〜異世界で神獣にハメられました〜】ミニアニメ
d:
A short anime commemorating the release of the BL manga's second volume.

Kotone is a fudanshi. One day while he was buying BL manga outside of a manga stand, a truck loses control and kills him with BL manga all over him. To his surprise, he wakes up in an Asian ancient-looking palace. A man named Nagi, that is half serpent, tells him that he is now his Miko. They need to have sex in order for Nagi to become a higher being and become a Dragon. Kotone knows everything about BL and he realizes that he will be the bottom. Kotone will use his knowledge of BL to not fall in love and not a bottom in this Isekai world.

"​In this world, there is good and evil... and one cannot exist without the other."

Thirty-three year old Lance Hunter has no memory of his past lives, but the scars of his former selves remain etched in his skin. As the only remaining Exorcist in London, Lance is hired to investigate a series of gruesome murders connected to a sinister cult. Accompanied by Gil, a mysterious policeman, Lance uses his spiritual powers to unravel the tangled truth of this case, unaware of the dark, sinister corners into which his new partner's twisted desires may lead.

(Source: TOKYOPOP)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.

A collection of short stories that take a refreshing and humorous look at the sexual relationships between young people in Japan.

Love is love. Someday, the pain of being in love will be an endearing memory. No matter who the feelings are towards, no matter what form it takes, all love and lifestyles have the same value. An omnibus anime tells the stories of "The wedding of an ex", "a student and a teacher at an all-boys' school" and "childhood friends whose bodies and hearts change with adolescence."

j: ぼくと仁義なきおじさん
d: The story follows Yuuhi, an elementary school student who is home-sitting alone every day. One day, all of a sudden, his neighbor, Mr. Aoi, who lives upstairs, falls in his room leaving a hole in the ceiling. Yuuhi finds out that his neighbor is a cool looking man with a secret side he doesn’t want anyone to know. What does he want to hide so badly? The comedy about a good-looking gangster and a kind-hearted boy and their secret is ready to start!
A young girl has her interest piqued by an enigmatic beauty whom she believes to be a witch.

Meguru Garai is a normal high school boy, except for the vivid dreams he has about a past life in a fantasy world. One day, a new transfer student, Kotaro Kongochi, suddenly arrived. Meguru found himself reunited with a friend from his dream life whom he thought he would never actually meet, but something was different about this Kotaro...? 

(Source: Comic Bushiroad, translated)

Note: Chapter 12 was split into two parts and there are two bonus chapters.

j: 狛田さんを困らせたい
d:
Komada-san is a petite high school girl who is easily flustered.
Her junior, Kagai-san, who is big in many ways, is always teasing Komada-san and causing her trouble!
There is only one reason for Kagai-san to be messing with her, because....

j: しおりを探すページたち
d: The story of two girls with a shared love of books falling in love at the library.

n: Kamigette Sou Iu Koto desu ka
r: Kamigette Sou Iu Koto desu ka
j: 神ゲーってそういうことですか
d:
Senoo Anna recently got a job at a social game company called Kami Games, which turns out to be run by actual Gods.
Sexy... a selfish idol... an alcoholic... someone who loves cute girls... various other Gods and... a black lily?
Game development begins!

j: ドリーム☆ジャンボ☆ガール
d: Chie is a girl really anxious about her future and aims for Tokyo University, Kanae is quite a silly girl. One day Kanae decides to buy plenty of lottery tickets, and they hit the first prize! Which means they won 700 millions yens ?! Such a sudden pressure makes Chie unable to concentrate on her exams... Now she's desperate !! With all that money in her pocket she's going to enjoy her life at the fullest ! A money and girls comedy that begins by hitting the jackpot at the lottery !!

j: 吉富昭仁作品集 BLUE DROP
d:
A collection of five sci-fi one-shots from the creator of Eat-Man, set in a world where people are still dealing with the repercussions of a war fought with aliens many years ago.

1. KAMINOKO (神子 ～KAMINOKO～); Dengeki Comic Gao! 2005-02

2. BLUE DROP: Kowareta Tenshi (BLUE DROP ～壊れた天使～, BLUE DROP: Broken Angel); Dengeki Comic Gao! 2005-09

3. KAIJIN (海人 ～KAIJIN～); Dengeki Comic Gao! 2004-08

4. BLUE DROP: Tenshi no Yakusoku (BLUE DROP ～天使の約束～, BLUE DROP: The Angel's Promise); Dengeki Comic Gao! 2005-12

5. BLUE DROP: Tenshi no Sentaku (BLUE DROP ～天使の選択～, BLUE DROP: The Angel's Choice); Dengeki Comic Gao! 2006-02

j: 思春期と男子校!?と中野くん
d: Hajime Nakano is forced by his mother to enroll at a newly opened all boys high school, and he laments over having to spend the next three years surrounded by other guys. However, he doesn't know that all of the other students are girls secretly pretending to be guys, and each of them think they are the only girl in the whole school.

Yukimura is the formidable VP of the student body. However, he has a past which he doesn't want to be discovered. The only person who knows about his secret is his childhood friend, Shinonome, the number-one problem student in the school! How far would Yukimura go to silence Shinonome!?

n: How My Cute Girlfriend and I Started a Love Story
r: Watashi to Kanojo no Kawaii Koi no Hajimekata
j: 私と彼女のかわいい恋のはじめ方
d:
Yoshiko Yokozawa is an office lady who loves cute things and being cute herself. Because of this, she is often not taken seriously and she is fed up with it. On the other hand, Chiaki Kurisu, a sales representative from a trading company, always seems very serious when she visits for business. For some reason, Kurisu suddenly invites Yokozawa to dinner!? Outside of work, Kurisu-san is completely different from her usual business-like behavior, being totally open and vulnerable...!?

“This woman, is cuter than me!?”

You can’t help but fall for her. ♡ Adult girls-love ♡

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

Note: Includes eight extra chapters.

j: サムライハイスクール
d: In a modern country where the government is controlled by a Martial Shogun and samurai receive much respect, there lives identical twins of the Sakakido family. Kou, the brother, is very feminine, excels at cooking, cleaning, arts and crafts. Tsukiko, the sister, is masculine, loves fighting and is a combat genius. The twins learn about the Samurai High School, where men test their strength and women test their femininity, but the only way they can attend is by swapping places. If they are to be found cheating, they will be executed so they have to overcome their gender differences and maintain their secret.
The story of "Hard", a bounty hunter living in New-York and seeking revenge.

j: きっと王子様がなんて
d: Sakura, who continues to live alone even after reaching the age of 30, decides to marry in order to reassure his parents. But the truth is… he’s an otomen who likes cute stuff and is a closet gay man. Keeping these circumstances hidden, he goes to a marriage counselor and reunites with his younger childhood friend Yuusuke by chance.

n: My Classmate Ren-kun is Kinda Scary
r: Tonari no Ren-kun wa Chotto Kowai
j: 隣の蓮君はちょっと怖い
d:
The aggressive Ren and serious Tadaomi have been inseparable since elementary school. And even though Ren is kinda scary, he instantly melts when he's with Tadaomi. Everyone around them knows what's up...except for the two of them! ♡

(Source: Animate International)

Notes:

- Originally published on Twitter and Pixiv.

- Includes 14 extra chapters.

n: Watashi no Hatsukoi wa Hazukashisugite Dare ni mo Ienai
r: Watashi no Hatsukoi wa Hazukashisugite Dare ni mo Ienai
j: 私の初恋は恥ずかしすぎて誰にも言えない
d:
Chiaki is good-looking, academically excellent, athletic, and born into a well-off family with two beautiful sisters. He leads a smooth sailing life, but he still has one problem. He's not popular with girls, and has never once been in love! He vowed to make a fresh start in high school and spend his days being pampered by girls. The morning after making this vow, Chiaki wakes up to find that he himself has turned into a girl.

He is shocked to find an unfamiliar face staring back at him in the mirror, but when he looks again, he sees a very cute girl in the reflection. He immediately goes to show off his new look to his twin sister Kaede, who happens to be very popular with the girls, but there is also something very strange happening to her…

n: Shitsuren Shita node Vtuber Hajimetara Toshiue no Onee-san ni Motemashita
r: Shitsuren Shita node Vtuber Hajimetara Toshiue no Onee-san ni Motemashita
j: 失恋したのでVtuberはじめたら年上のお姉さんにモテました
d: Yuki Himemura, who had long harbored feelings for a senpai in his school club, learned that his crush now have a boyfriend. Devastated, he decided to become a VTuber like the one that both he and his senpai admired. He spent his entire savings on the VTuber setup, but when he opened his avatar design, it turned out to be an unexpectedly beautiful 3D model — of a girl!? And that's how he unintentionally started pretending to be a girl online!?

n: She, Her Camera and Her Seasons
r: Kanojo to Camera to Kanojo no Kisetsu
j: 彼女とカメラと彼女の季節
d: Akari is a third-year student who has spent her high school career sticking to the straight and narrow...but her attention is caught by Yuki Sendo, the short-haired, standoffish girl in her class who seems to buck the trend. Akari can't seem to stop seeking Yuki out, and her feelings rapidly develop into something more than girlish friendship. But Yuki seems to have eyes only for her childhood friend, Rintaro Kagawa...who himself seems to have feelings for Akari. It's a mess...and one that threatens to grow even messier as Akari navigates between what she wants and what's expected of her...

j: トーキョー・ガールズ・デストラクション
d: In the 2020’s the Japanese female culture was extremely corrupted in the eyes of the first women prime minister. To bring back the beauty of Japanese femininity, she created the Amazon Academy, a girls-only school, on an artificial island isolated in the middle of the Pacific Ocean. Amesu Kumi just transferred into Amazon Academy to investigate the death of her older sister, Towa, who also attended the school until she died in a shroud of mystery. The only clue she has is the name Burai Sachiko left in Towa’a cell phone. How could Kumi have known that the school literally turns into a battlefield when classes are over; where petite girls beat each other senseless in order to survive.
Extra chapter from I Married My Best Friend to Shut My Parents Up.

A girl goes to the seaside on her class field trip and accidentally meets a mysterious handsome boy, after talking, she hears a dramatic story about a bird and fish, finally the kind girl decides to help the bird fulfill its last wish.

Part.1: "Capsule" Arc (Volumes 1-5)

Lately, Kouhei can't get his friend Kurara out of his mind. Even though he has known her since elementary school, all of a sudden, ever since she came back from summer vacation, he has been crushing on her...hard.

But something is different about Kurara—she's acting very oddly. Sometimes she seems wholesome, pure, and innocent, and at other times she is extremely forward and unabashed. Kouhei soon learns that Kurara has multiple personalities—and decides to help her keep her secret from their classmates. But Kouhei finds himself struggling between helping Kurara as a friend and trying to win her heart... which is a challenge, since she has many!

Part.2: "Secret" Arc (The Next Revolution; Volumes 6-16)

Akira Hatsushiba is just your typical, average high school kid . . . until a glitch in a Gacha Gacha video game changes his life forever. Now, every time Akira sneezes, his entire body undergoes a gender-bending switcheroo! That’s right, Akira is always just an achoo away from getting in touch with his feminine side. But it’s not all bad. Akira has had a crush on Yurika Sakuraba ever since he first laid eyes on her. He’s always been too shy, but now that he can change into a girl, Akira finally has a chance to get close to Yurika. Being a girl certainly has its advantages!

(Source: Del Rey)

Included one-shot:

Volume 13: Miniature

j: ポルノスーパースター
d: Being a virgin employee, Yamashita had dreamed to sleep at least once with his most favorite gay porn star, Hikaru. From there, he has an unbelieveable encounter when he left from work! During the middle of the intercourse, however, it turns out that the man isn't Hikaru, but someone called Asami Ryuuichi...! "...Who on earth are you?!"

j: 魔法少女リリカルなのはViVid
d:
The series takes place four years after the events of Mahou Shoujo Lyrical Nanoha StrikerS, during which Nanoha Takamachi rescued and adopted a young girl named Vivio, who is the reincarnation of the Sankt Kaiser, Olivie Segbrecht. After entering her fourth year of elementary school, Vivio is given her own intelligence device, Sacred Heart, and gains the power to transform using her adult Sankt Kaiser mode. She soon comes across a girl named Einhart Stratos who, similar to Vivio, is the descendant of another Sankt Kaiser ruler, Claus G.S. Ingvalt. As Einhart becomes determined to prove her fighting style is the strongest, Vivio befriends her and, together with her friends, enters a martial arts tournament where they fight against various opponents and learn more about their past lives.

Included one-shot:

Volume 2: 5th Anniversary Collaboration Comic: Fate/stay night x Mahou Shoujo Lyrical Nanoha

A chance meeting blossomed to love between two girls.

But it’s quite a peculiar couple: Sayuri is ordinary in every way, while her love interest, Yoriko, is a refined lady who seems to be completely lacking in common sense. Graceful attraction between two very different personalities, a sweet and slightly dazzling love story.

j: サジちゃんの病み日記
d: Saji has a girl that she likes. That pure feeling is not understood by others, but surely love is the truth. Take, steal, stab, take away... it is also love.

Rune, an “ex”-mermaid, comes out from the ocean to be with the human she’s been pining for, Riku, her first love. But as fate would have it, she finds out she’ll never be able to become one with humans … This is the first volume of a sexy, yet pure, romantic comedy, a bit risqué—and sure to make you laugh out loud!

j: ガールズバンドクライ
d: Feeling out of place in the countryside, high school dropout Nina Iseri moves to Tokyo. After a rough first day and getting locked out of her apartment, she meets her favorite guitarist, Momoka Kawaragi. The two put on a street performance together and decide to start a band with three other girls. While each girl faces her own struggles, their passion for music keeps their dreams alive.

n: Delinquent Daddy and Tender Teacher: Four-Leaf Clovers
j: 元ヤンパパ と ヒツジ先生 よつば
d: Elementary-school teacher Hitsuji has been dating Hatoyama for a year now, spending his days peacefully with him and his adorable son, Hinata. The arrival of another spring ushers in Hinata’s third year of elementary school, and this time his teacher isn’t Hitsuji! Hatoyama and Hinata are understandably anxious about this, but it seems Hitsuji is grappling with his own feelings about the situation as well. Then, when someone from Hatoyama’s delinquent past comes back into his orbit, Hitsuji’s insecurities threaten to get the better of him. Will he be able to defend his place at Hatoyama’s side?

n: Lycoris Recoil Official Comic Anthology: React
r: Lycoris Recoil Koushiki Comic Anthology: React
j: リコリス・リコイル 公式コミックアンソロジー リアクト
d: Welcome to Café LycoReco! Join Chisato, Takina, and their Lycoris co-workers inside for a taste of their lives off-the-clock from Lycoris duty, whether it's devising new menu items or balancing the books!

r: Ai wo Utau Yori Ore ni Oborero!
j: 愛を歌うより俺に溺れろ!
d:
Mizuki is the female “prince” of her all-girls school and the lead guitarist in an all-girl rock band. Akira is the male “princess” of his all-boys school and wants to join her band. Love may be on his mind, but romance is difficult when everyone keeps mistaking Mizuki for a boy and Akira for a girl!

When the lead singer of Blaue Rosen announces she is moving overseas, Akira does all he can to convince Mizuki and her bandmates to let him join. But will a resistant Mizuki allow him into her band, much less her heart?

n: Rezu Goukon to Mayoikonda Nonke no Musume
r: Rezu Goukon to Mayoikonda Nonke no Musume
j: レズ合コンと迷い込んだノンケの娘

d: Alex and Rita are two souls who died at the same moment on different ends of the earth. This is the story of their interactions with the humans who can see them as they travel towards each other.

n: I'll Make a Habit of It
d: Shiratori Nagisa is a pink haired singing idol, continually badgered by her father to find new disciples for the family dojo. In an attempt to gain free-time as a normal kid, she cuts her hair and cross-dresses as a high-school boy. "Ootori Nagisa" enrolls in a run-down school, falling in love with a rival school's gang leader, Nosaka Akira. She soon finds out Nosaka-kun is a fan of Nagisa - The Idol. Keeping up the charade, they manage to sneak time together. Rivals for Nagisa's affection, BOTH their dojo-running fathers, as well as martial artist animals and an up-in-coming Idol conspire to make thier lives a complicated as possible.

n: Imasugu Onii-chan ni Imouto da tte Iitai!
r: Imasugu Onii-chan ni Imouto da tte Iitai!
j: いますぐお兄ちゃんに妹だっていいたい!
d:
Rikuto had a new younger brother Ayumu after his father’s remarriage. However, little did he know that Ayumu was actually a girl and it was under her mother’s orders that she pretend to be a boy to him. Every day, his heart beats a little faster around his overly cute brother (sister), while her heart aches in having to hide her true identity from her kind brother.

With the arrival of spring, Rikuto and Ayumu begin attending the popular private school Asaoka Academy, with Ayumu dressed up as a girl. As Rikuto becomes friends with his classmates, he notices that they all have something missing. His friend from middle school, Matsuri, has lost sight of what it meant to be a girl. The cool-mannered Mao dresses as a boy even though she is a girl. The extremely shy class rep Kimika wishes to change herself. With Ayumu by his side, he sets out to help them seek out what they are missing.

n: Sore wo Ai to Yobu Dake
r: Sore wo Ai to Yobu Dake
d: Music video directed by China for the song Sore wo Ai to Yobu Dake by Mafumafu.

Yuzu Tomita, an assassin by trade, was given a mysterious order: "Kill the man you are about to meet." But what appeared in front of Yuzu was a person who looked exactly like him...!? This is an unpredictable "hitman's" action comedy by the "Blue Striker" duo of Yoxal Shibata and Makoto Sawa!

Chloe and Mia are twin maids who work for the Evans family.
Actually, they share a thrilling secret...?

A peek into the daily lives of two slightly naughty and very cute maids!

n: Aniki no Kanojo ni Naru, Onnanoko ni Nacchatta Otouto.
r: Aniki no Kanojo ni Naru, Onnanoko ni Nacchatta Otouto.
j: 兄貴の彼女になる、女の子になっちゃった弟。
d: Note: R18 extras are published on the author's Fantia account.

j: えんどうくんの実験ノート
d: Sequel of Endou-kun no Kansatsu Nikki.

Kikuchi woke up one fine morning to a message from his ex-girlfriend telling him that she was seeing someone else. Having to go to work after such a crappy experience, he was faced with his uni friend, Sera’s boyfriend, Akaboshi who was also his adorable student. Usually Akaboshi’s rather stoic and aloof but in front of Sera, he just brimmed with so much happiness. Sadly, Sera harboured a secret that will threaten their relationship and poor Kikuchi, being Sera’s good friend, knew about it is caught in between. It didn’t help that Kikuchi’s falling for his student too…

j: ハローモーニングスター
d:
"I didn't want to realize this... I'm still in love with you."

Atsuto is a core member of a 5-man boy band called "L Planet" and Yuki is a charismatic vocalist in another band at the same company named "Realis." These two studs are rumored to be rivals vying for the top spot as the next big superstar, but when they were still training to be stars, they used to be - lovers. They began to drift apart when Atsuto made his debut before Yuki and now their relationship is but a mere shadow of what it once was. Their relationship is awkward at best and yet the flame of desire still flickers within Atsuto's heart...

(Source: MangaPlaza)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.

n: Shoushin Otoko ni Haru no Arashi
r: Shoushin Otoko ni Haru no Arashi
d:
“To prefer an old man like me, you’re really a strange one.”

An awkward honor student and a peevish writer in his 30s. A 200% pure heart-pounding age gap romance.

Renowned for his illustrious military achievements, Jing Shao is unexpectedly betrayed and falls from grace, finding himself abandoned by all but one: his male spouse, whom he had neglected for over a decade. Given another chance by the universe, he vows to turn over a new leaf and win back the love of his husband. However, this journey of love and redemption is fraught with challenges, teaching Jing Shao the true meaning of commitment and the strength of enduring affection.

It's an age where aliens, monsters and other dangers threaten the Earth, and various heroes have risen to protect it. Supporting these heroes are the human defense forces, of which the Kitajishi sisters Miyuki and Yuri are a part. Specifically, their office is for hero consultation, and they help heroes solve their problems, but they also help evacuation procedures during emergencies. Yuri was formerly an immensely powerful and popular magic girl, but now she helps protect people in a more human way. In their first case, they consult with a hero who has lost his powers, and is trying to find a way to live as an ordinary human.

Mahiro has two goals in life: first, to finally confess to his childhood friend who he loved for so long and second, to become a famous model. But there are various obstacles in Mahiro's path! For one thing, he dresses as a girl, named Hanabusu Arisu, when modeling. As if that wasn't enough, every woman in his vicinity gets the urge to spread her legs because of the special pheromone he emits! Will Mahiro ever come to confess his love to Miwa, or will he simply widen his harem and get engulfed in endless orgy? Find out for yourself!

One day, inconscient Tatsumi came to the cafe where Tsuburaya works. Their relationship was just supposed to be customer and staff but Tsuburaya ends up coming in and out of Tatsumi’s house after meeting by chance during the cafe’s regular holiday. 

After spending time with Tatsumi, Tsuburaya got to know him more and he later starts to be aware of that certain emotion…

Attention Girls! Is loving another worth it? As our play unfolds at Saint Theresa Girls Academy, this anthology is filled to the brim with young women's passion. She-wolf, Natsuki, and the transfer student, Fuyuka's, slapstick days are portrayed in "She-Wolf", Haruka who loves grabbing other girls' chests, and the best friend who is interested in her, Akiho, star in "Expressions of Love," Reiko and Ayano, two teachers who find adult love in "First Kiss" and more, these stories are full of breast-grabbing, kinda sexy fun! Three female couples' stories interweave in this Girl's Love Comic collection!

(Source: JManga)

1. Aijou♥Hyougen (愛情♥表現, Expressions of Love)

2. Onna Ookami (オンナオオカミ, She-wolf)

3. First Kiss

4. Gyakushuu no Akazukin-chan (逆襲の赤ズキンチャン, Little Red Riding Hood Strikes Back)

5. Haru Natsu Aki Fuyu (Spring, Summer, Winter, Fall)

6. Kanojo (彼女, Her)

Erika is a normal student, who one day due to special circumstances will live with another girl named Yuri! But Yuri dreams of "marrying" her and will do anything to fulfill that dream.

Includes a prologue chapter.

Ever since the day Ran Kurono's older brother was killed while protecting Sei Ohtori, she has dedicated her skills and life to one day becoming the First Knight of the next head of the Ohtori family, even concealing the fact that she's a woman forever. For generations the Kurono family has served the Ohtori family as their First Knight, but 11 other lower knights with ill intentions of using the Ohtori family's authority vie for that title. Not only that, but Sei is being tested for being suitable for the title of head of the family. Upon entering Saint Locks Academy, the days of both Ran and Sei's trials begin, all the while being helped by Sei's untidy and unrefined fiance, Ibara Tennou.
Summary of the Fuyu no Semi OVA with revised animation and some extra scenes.
Yutaka gets his yearly letter from his beloved older brother, but this summer something is different about it...

j: エロイカより愛をこめて
d:
Set in Continental Europe, it depicts the adventures of British aristocrat Dorian Red Gloria and his alter ego Eroica, Europe's most wanted international art thief. His nemesis — Major Klaus Heinz von dem Eberbach, a German NATO intelligence officer — has tried for years to catch the man who claims each crime scene with a card signed "From Eroica with Love." Things are just getting started when a trio of telepathically linked teenagers becomes aware of Dorian's identity and plans to capture him. But their plot goes awry as the master thief branches out — no longer content with stealing great art, he's moving on. Now the trio must foil his attempts to kidnap their leader, Caesar, as they try to save the great art treasures of Europe!

(Source: CMX)

Note: Includes 24 extra chapters.

Rose became an assassin to survive as an immigrant refugee. Her lover, Benika, is an ordinary schoolgirl, who wanted to keep their homosexual romance hidden from her father, a priest at the church where Rose goes to confess her sins of murder. Rose's employer, the "Organization," is also on the move, as Rose's personal and professional relationships are about to get very, very messy!?!

(Source: Comic Days, translated)

Note: Chapter count includes one epilogue and five omake chapters.

n: Is It Wrong to Try to Pick Up Girls in a Dungeon? Familia Chronicle: Episode Lyu
r: Dungeon ni Deai wo Motomeru no wa Machigatteiru Darou ka: Familia Chronicle - episode Ryuu
j: ダンジョンに出会いを求めるのは間違っているだろうか　ファミリアクロニクル　episode リュー
d:
For the skilled former adventurer Ryu, it's another eventful day at the Benevolent Mistress! A certain couple's only daughter has been kidnapped, bringing Ryu out into the streets to search for her, in the name of justice and Astrea. Her investigation of the missing child eventually leads her to a lawless area of the Labyrinth City, the Grand Casino, where money and power decide everything!

This is the start of the Gale Wind's tale in the city of Orario, home of the Dungeon and adventure!

j: ミルグラム 第三審
d:
Third season of the interactive collaborative multimedia music project between DECO*27 and Takuya Yamanaka.

n: Kidou Senshi Gundam: Suisei no Majo - Seishun Frontier
r: Kidou Senshi Gundam: Suisei no Majo - Seishun Frontier
j: 機動戦士ガンダム 水星の魔女 青春フロンティア
d:
This work is a spin-off comic of the TV anime Mobile Suit Gundam: Witch of Mercury that began broadcasting in October 2022.

It is a parallel work set in a near-future Japan, depicting the encounter between high school girls Suletta and Miorine.

When Takagi Akira, an owner of an apartment, was in town, he ran into a scene where a man, Oodoi, saved an old man from a gang. Akira fell for Oodoi’s manly courage and took him in his apartment. Oodoi found Akira’s apartment comfy and spent time there. Akira thought Oodoi's manly act was now part of the past... But when Akira was harassed by mobs and about to sell his apartment, it was Oodoi who saved his life. Truth is, Oodoi is a yakuza and…

j: 異世界転生百合アンソロジー
d:
One day, when I woke up, I was in a world I didn't know about! A fantasy en solo appearance where girls foster new relationships in a different world!

Story 1 - A Goddess' Blessing and a Convenient Life in Another World (Yuu Nonaka)

Story 2 - I am a Princess for Just One Knight (merryhachi)

Story 3 - The Case of Being Confined by a Yandere Girl in Another World (Doromaru Numachi)

Story 4 - A Harem Skill Was Equipped by Default (Rio Ihara)

Story 5 - The You I Met Reflected in Me (Kiyan)

Story 6 - The Essence of the You I Met Once Again (Kiyan)

Story 7 - A Succubus' Love (Sekihara)

Story 8 - Starting Life as a Cat in Another World (Sumire)

When Yukari meets classmate Mahoro Tachibana for the first time, the two of them can’t help but feel like they know each other. Yukari senses that they had a major connection in the past, but was their relationship friendly or deadly?
Yae and Chitose have been dating for one year. Their relationship continues in this sweet and fluffy slice-of-life story.

HER is a series of character portraits, loosely strung together by everyday circumstances.

The story begins with a woman who wants to be loveable - and loved - and who has a fixation on shoes. Her hairdresser's fear of the future is the subject of the second chapter. A schoolgirl whose hair she cuts sees her older female neighbor kissing her female lover goodbye. In the past, the neighbor had a difficult relationship with her mother. The neighbor's lover was rejected by her first love. The couple sitting next to them at the cafe have their own issues.
It's okay to use a lot of ingredients. Hold off on eating the food with your fingers. Crunch. Chew. Nibble. Swallow. Who could frown when faced with such delicious food and sake?

Wachi is a young CEO. He's rich, handsome and great in bed... but his personality is a different story. He views everyone he meets as a means to an end, and it seems impossible to have a real, heartfelt connection with him. Then, he meets Makio. As Wachi begins visiting the bar where Makio works, he finds himself enjoying their daily interactions and actually... experiencing emotions?! Could it be that he's actually falling for someone for real...?

(Source: TOKYOPOP)

Note: Includes 10 extra chapters.

At work, you're the cold, strict senior colleague. At home, you're the gentle, sweet lover. Which one is the real you? The extraordinary Itsuki Tsutsui debuts with a 59-page one-shot about a secret, warped obsession no one can know about!!

Saotome is an established author that hasn't published anything in so long that his fans think he's deceased. The reason for his long break is because he's determined that his upcoming release contain a scene where the protagonist tells the object of her affection her feelings...and he just can't bring himself to write it. Enter Sasasori, Saotome's new editor and former high school friend. Sasasori knows Saotome has it in him to include some romance in his stories, since back in the day, he himself was the object of Saotome's affections!

Princess, hero, priestess, witch, and maid.

If you had to choose one to be your queen, who would it be?

The war between humans and demons had just ended, but the world still feared more conflict. The only way to assure peace is for the Demon Lord (female) to take a human queen!

Which heroine will you choose? Your choice will help guide the story to its conclusion! It's a new kind of reader-participation harem comedy!

n: Home Center-goto Yobidasareta Watashi no Daimeikyuu Renovation!
r: Home Center-goto Yobidasareta Watashi no Daimeikyuu Renovation!
j: ホームセンターごと呼び出された私の大迷宮リノベーション!

d: By chance, the exorcist Xiaoyu was forced into a living arrangement with Heiyao, the succubus who killed her foster-father. But Heiyao seemed to have lost her memories!? Xiaoyu didn't trust Heiyao, so she decided to stay and keep an eye on her. Heiyao didn't mind, as she tried to tease and seduce Xiaoyu in order to feed her hunger… They might fight all the time, but they both know there are other dangers lurking, with whoever was behind Xiaoyu's father's murder, whoever sealed away Heiyao's memories, and something else…

One day, high school student Aragaki notices that a ghost is haunting him. Aragaki thought he was the only person who can see the ghost, until his crush and classmate, Asahikawa, points it out! What's more, Asahikawa says that the ghost told him that Aragaki likes him...? Could this eerie situation actually lead to Aragaki finding love through the help of this ghost?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

Notes:

- All chapters were split into two parts in the original serialization and later combined in the volume release.

- Includes two extra chapters, both not included in the volume.

Short and unpopular Sawa gets his first love confession. And it’s from a tall and dark WIMP! His name is Ono. He even went so far as to follow Sawa to his workplace and then has the nerve to say “Just forget it”. In any case, he’s a timid one. So what was up with that outrageous confession?! A moving story about a weakling and his strong-willed senpai. Also includes stories like, “Love in a One Room Mansion”, “Love for the Bullied” and “The Master and the Stray Kitten”.

1-2. Kiss Shite Yowamushi-kun!

3. One Room Mansion no Renai Jijou (Love in a One Room Mansion)

4. Koisuru Ijimekko-chan (Love for the Bullied)

5. Hiroware Koneko to Goshujinsama (The Master and the Stray Kitten)

Instead of saying what he wants to say or do what he wants to do, Sawahata smiles to avoid getting involved. His school life seems so boring and nothing interests him anymore. Until he finds Hoshizaki glaring at him from across the classroom. The no-eyebrows-face intriques him, pulling at emotions he doesn't know he has. What does Hoshizaki really want from him? And what should he do now that he can no longer avoid Hoshizaki?
